target_customer: Health conscious consumers wanting at-cost preventive testing, starting with executives in Singapore and then the US
problem: Preventive labs, scans and genetics are expensive and hard to interpret. Mito sells testing at cost plus clinician review with a membership.
business_model: Membership ($9 per month or $99 per year) plus at-cost tests, consults and at-home draw fees
product_category: Consumer preventive health and longevity marketplace

founders.name: Kenneth Lou
founders.background_notes: Seedly background from Vulcan Post and e27 coverage.

founders.name: Tee-Ming Chew
founders.background_notes: Role from Tatler Asia photo caption.

founders.name: Ryan Ware
founders.background_notes: Styled Dr; the company site now lists him as scientific and care team advisor.

investors: Angels from ShopBack, Carousell, PatSnap, Glints, SingLife, Rainforest, Ohmyhome

technical_complexity.rationale: A consumer web platform aggregating lab partners and clinician review. The hard parts are partner logistics and regulation, not engineering.

defensibility.rationale: At cost pricing and clinician review are easy for larger entrants to copy; lab partner relationships are the main barrier.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Competing biomarker services grew by 2025 per roundups. No acquisition of Mito found.

market_need_then: Rising consumer interest in longevity and preventive screening; founder says his father's cancer motivated the focus (podcast summary). No quantified demand data found.

branding.name_origin: Company site says the name comes from mitochondria, the powerhouses that generate energy in cells.

identity.logo: Not described by any source found
identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and transparent, stresses clear prices, and says it will tell you when you need less testing

branding.community_and_virality: Press from Tatler Asia, Vulcan Post, e27, TechNode and Longevity.Technology; founder podcast appearances; Nas Daily as investor.

brand_strength.rationale: Meaningful name story and regional press coverage; limited evidence of organic community or virality.

pivots.to: Health screenings and AI personalized plans
pivots.why: Mentors and peers advised a change (Tatler Asia)

pivots.from: In person blood draws and scans in Singapore
pivots.why: Company announced discontinuing in person services in Singapore

outcome_analysis: Mito raised a US$1.3M pre-seed in April 2023 and a US$2.2M seed in March 2025, for about US$4M in total per the company. It exited in person services in Singapore in March 2025 to go digital first and focus on the US, showing a market shift, but the company remains active so the outcome is still open.
notes: Founder bios (Seedly, TraceTogether) come from search result summaries of Vulcan Post, e27 and Tatler Asia, not pages I opened; education not found. YC page says founded 2023 and lists only Lou and Kek as titled founders; Chew and Ware are named as co-founders in the launch post and press. The company site shows a total raised of US$4M. Seedly acquirer is reported inconsistently (Hyphen Group or ShopBack). Investor list for the seed is from Longevity.Technology and may be incomplete. Round amounts: S$1.7M is about US$1.3M at the time. Dated competitor sources not found near April 2023, so the list is empty.
